title: Keep What You Wrote
description:
Kiosk messages vanished every time the Pod restarted. Guests noticed.

Claim storage with a PVC (or bind as the brief allows) and mount it at the required path. After a recreate, the data you wrote should still be there.

**Meant for:** PV / PVC mounts.

problemStatement.brief: Claim storage with a PVC and mount it into Guestbook at the required path — data must survive a recreate.
